verdict.line: You lose if you let him land E (Death's Grasp) into Q (Obliterate) for free; you win by forcing all-ins only when his W (Indestructible) shield is already burned.

brief.thesis: This is a measured 49.1% over 3288 games because neither side has a structural edge in the trade — Mordekaiser's Q (Obliterate) and E (Death's Grasp) hit hard but are both single-target skillshots with real cooldowns, so your E (Apprehend) pull-ins land just as often as his do. The fight is decided by who gets caught without their defensive cooldown: his W (Indestructible) shield or your R (Noxian Guillotine) execute window.

theirWindow.when: W shield is up and charged
theirWindow.what: He can tank your all-in and sustain through your Q (Decimate) healing, so don't dump your E (Apprehend) engage into a full shield — bait it out with a poke first.

yourWindow.when: his W just went on cooldown (12-8s)
yourWindow.what: This is your all-in window — land E (Apprehend) to pull him in, stack Hemorrhage with Q (Decimate), and finish with R (Noxian Guillotine) before his shield comes back up.

start.why: 81% pick rate at 49.8% over 3390 games — the extra AD and sustain let you trade autos into his Q (Obliterate) poke without losing the lane-sustain war.

boots.why: 65% pick rate at 49.2% — the magic resist directly cuts the damage from his Q (Obliterate) and E (Death's Grasp), both of which are his entire kit's damage source.

core.why: First item in all three top-performing build paths (53.7-61.3% win rate); the active haste lets you close the gap after his E (Death's Grasp) whiffs.
Appears in the two highest win-rate paths (53.7%, 56%); stacking magic resist is the direct counter to an all-magic-damage opponent.
Paired with Youmuu's + Dead Man's Plate or Force of Nature for 56-61.3% win rates; the bleed-out-over-time conversion keeps you alive through his burst windows.

runes.keystoneWhy: 52.9% win rate at 28.1% pick — the stacking adaptive force and healing on takedown directly offset his W (Indestructible) sustain in extended trades, which is how this matchup is actually won.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the highest-performing combo at 50.4% over 29.7% pick rate — Ignite punishes his lack of a dash the moment you land E (Apprehend), since he can't escape your true-damage execute range.

playing.title: Track his W cooldown, not his HP
playing.detail: Indestructible (12-8s cooldown) is a damage-stored shield he can pop to heal — all-in the moment it's down, not when he looks low, since a charged shield erases your burst.

playing.title: Save E for after his E whiffs
playing.detail: His Death's Grasp (16-8s cooldown) pulls you to him first; if he misses it, your Apprehend pull now has zero counter-engage risk for the next 8-16 seconds.

playing.title: Stack Hemorrhage before committing R
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine's true damage scales with Hemorrhage stacks — land Q (Decimate) and an auto first so your execute threshold is lower when you commit.

playing.title: Don't facetank his passive proc
playing.detail: Darkness Rise triggers after his 3rd hit on you and grants him a damage aura plus Move Speed — disengage or reset the trade before he lands that third hit.

playing.title: Respect his E range over yours
playing.detail: Death's Grasp (700 range) outreaches your Apprehend (535 range) — he can initiate first if you're both at max range, so close distance before trading.

playing.title: Play around his R timer after level 6
playing.detail: Realm of Death (140-80s cooldown) isolates you 1v1 and steals your stats on a kill — don't overextend alone once he's level 6 and his ultimate is up.

playing.title: Use Q healing to win extended fights
playing.detail: Decimate heals you for champions hit by the blade — stand in blade range, not handle range, so your sustain actually outpaces his W-shield healing.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.19.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being nuked by Mordekaiser’s abilities. Try to fight him when the opponent steps in your range to nuke him in one burst.
